claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Amisulpride is a selective dopamine D2/D3 receptor antagonist; at 2.5 µM for 5 days it is not expected to reduce viability in most cancer cell lines because dopamine receptor blockade is not a relevant cytotoxic driver in pooled cancer cell viability assays.
